Hi Lena — great to meet you, and welcome.

Thanks for the quick summary. For Redwood vendor creation we typically need:
- Completed vendor master template (attached)
- Signed W-9 (US entities)
- Bank verification letter or voided check for ACH setup
- Primary AP contact + remit-to email and preferred payment terms
- Beneficial ownership statement (if US entity > 25% ownership)

I've attached our redwood_vendor_master_template.xlsx. Fill that and return the W-9 + bank letter and we'll push it through procurement. Marissa (cc'd) will run the legal/name matching and Kim (cc'd) will route it to AP for ACH onboarding.

A couple items to note:
- Preferred routing: email PO to suppliers@redwood.com or via EDI (we can enable later).
- Default payment term for new vendors is Net 30 unless otherwise agreed and approved by finance. If you need Net 45, note it in the template and we'll route for manager approval.
- For pilot POs we can create a provisional vendor code and do a small $500 test PO to validate remittance.

Please upload completed docs to the Drive link below or reply with the attachments. Once we have everything, target turnaround is 4–7 business days.

Drive upload: https://drive.google.com/redwood/onboarding/syla-supply

Thanks — looking forward to getting you set up.
